learning_plane: absent (no learning-plane code exists at this commit)
protocol: Fixed automated protocol, no human in the loop: review-plan --accept, run, accept --task 1 only when Meshloop's own checks passed (node AwaitingReview), resume, integrate --into main --accept-integrate; success is the exit code of the task's hidden tests run on main after integration. The plan is never adjusted or declined, so Adjust/Decline = 0 by protocol, not by measurement of a human.
state_carried: Each task x repetition runs in a new disposable Git repository with a new Meshloop store, so routing_feedback, quota_state, attempts and events start empty for every task (checked and recorded per run as routing_feedback_before). Nothing Meshloop stores carries across tasks or repetitions. Not controlled: vendor-side state outside the repository (harness CLI login, user-level config and instruction files, vendor caches and account quota windows).
